finding.claim: test_master_grows_two_volumes_per_collection checks only that the text `[master.volume_growth] copy_1 = 2` appears in the jobspec. It does not check that the file is mounted at /etc/seaweedfs/master.toml, so if the `volumes` mount is dropped or the path changes, the test still passes while the growth setting is gone, which r1's fails_when covers. The live six-bucket check cannot catch this either, because `-volume.max=0` on a TiB volume gives plenty of slots under the default copy_1 = 7.

fixes.change: new test asserts master.toml is rendered to local/ and mounted at /etc/seaweedfs/master.toml; seen failing with the mount pointed elsewhere.
